internal.name: TaskRepository
internal.rule: Task UUID/task_kind are immutable; repositories never commit internally

internal.name: WfmTaskRepository
internal.rule: Task No. is canonical attempt identity; one current owning RFC has append-only reassignment history; source projection is rebuildable from LLD-04; RETIRED Task Nos are permanent nonreuse authority

internal.name: TaskPlanRepository
internal.rule: plan revisions are immutable; current plan points to a newly accepted revision; Objective membership pins an exact accepted plan revision and never silently advances

internal.name: TaskExecutionRepository
internal.rule: execution evidence is append-only and current projection rebuildable. Exact no-history reads as execution_revision=0/not_started with no persisted projection/event. Any event requires a positive-revision projection, including corrected-to-not_started history; history/projection mismatch fails closed.

internal.name: TaskOutcomeRepository
internal.rule: accepted outcomes are completed|incomplete|cancelled_without_execution; first event is genesis and every material correction points to the exact current tip; current revision equals the owned linear event count/chain length and current pointer is that tip; exact absence requires no current row and no owned history; projection/history mismatch fails closed; Awaiting Review is derived, not accepted outcome

internal.name: TaskRelationshipRepository
internal.rule: direct SR/RFC links are Local-only; Device Reference links may belong to Local/WFM; history is preserved and targets are LLD-03 identities, never Network Element IDs

internal.name: TaskRetryRepository
internal.rule: every retry has one immediate predecessor; one attempt has at most one direct successor; retry identity is never reused

internal.name: TaskActivityLineageRepository
internal.rule: reviewed activity lineage supports competing-WFM detection; missing lineage never authorizes collapsing distinct Task Nos

internal.name: ObjectiveRepository
internal.rule: objective_id/MW identity never change; supersession/archive preserve row/history

internal.name: ObjectiveMembershipRepository
internal.rule: one Task has at most one current Objective; membership pins the exact reviewed Task-plan revision and history preserves prior Objective/plan context

internal.name: ObjectiveProjectionRepository
internal.rule: envelope/aggregate are transactional rebuildable projections; overlap uses indexed start < candidate_end AND end > candidate_start

internal.name: GroupingProposalRepository
internal.rule: proposal membership is persisted row-wise, exact and revision-bound; rejection suppression uses exact material-input fingerprint

internal.name: HistoricalObjectiveProposalRepository
internal.rule: provider Complete + valid source plan may suggest historical structure when no conflicting current operational plan exists; exact matching plan may be reused, otherwise AcceptHistoricalObjectiveProposal alone may create historical_source_structure plan; proposal/import never records execution/outcome/Inventory

internal.name: ObjectiveReviewRepository
internal.rule: review stores reviewed_at plus exact membership/outcome fingerprint and aggregate snapshot; later material correction invalidates currentness without editing old review

internal.name: OperationalCountInclusionRepository
internal.rule: exclusion is reporting-only and never deletes Task/Objective/source/audit history

registry_contract: This bounded registry preserves the exact internal repository declarations formerly held in the LLD-05 omnibus interfaces.json.
Repositories accept the declared reader or caller UnitOfWork and never commit or roll back independently.
